lines.en: label dormwarsfive1:
scene black
It was just like any other Friday...
lines.zh: 这本来只是个再普通不过的周五……

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro1
Except it wasn’t because it was time for the Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: 除了今天不是，因为宿舍战争的时间到了！

lines.en: : Ladies and gentlemen!
lines.zh: : 女士们，先生们！

lines.en: : And also Molly!
lines.zh: : 还有 Molly！

lines.en: : Are you going to do this every time?!
lines.zh: : 你们每次都要来这么一出吗？！

lines.en: : Tradition is tradition! You are loved and respected. And also necessary for at least two competitions this year!
lines.zh: : 传统就是传统！你被爱着，也被尊重着。而且今年至少有两项比赛还非你不可！

lines.en: : I...will take it!
lines.zh: : 我……接受了！

lines.en: : And I will continue with my introduction since I am basically just the queen of the Dorm Wars now!
lines.zh: : 那我就继续我的开场白了，毕竟我现在基本上就是宿舍战争的女王了！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro2
: Now — the title we’ve gone with this time is Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars - Heaven & Hell (And Heckin’ Hot Girls)!
lines.zh: : 那么——这次我们定下的标题是：超级无敌终极宿舍战争——天堂与地狱（还有超辣的妹子们）！

lines.en: : But you didn’t hear that subtitle from me and I am only just now finding out that it was added.
lines.zh: : 但那个副标题可不是从我这儿听去的，我也是刚刚才发现它被人加上了。

lines.en: : We needed more H’s.
lines.zh: : 我们需要更多 H 开头的词。

lines.en: : I am also surprised to suddenly find out it was Makoto who added it and not Uta, who is openly attracted to at least half of the class.
lines.zh: : 我也很惊讶地发现，加这个的人居然是 Makoto，而不是至少公然对半个班有想法的 Uta。

lines.en: : Correction! It’s not open, so you’ll never guess who and live in a permanent state of wondering if you’re in the 50%%!
lines.zh: : 更正一下！才没有公然，所以你们永远也猜不到是谁，只能一辈子活在「我是不是在那 50%% 里面」的疑惑里！

lines.en: : Am-
lines.zh: : 那个——

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: : Hah...
lines.zh: : 哈啊……

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Kirin. One day, someone other than me will appreciate your beauty.
lines.zh: : 别难过，Kirin。总有一天，除了我之外也会有人欣赏你的美貌的。

lines.en: : Can I continue or do y’all just wanna make out with each other for the rest of the day?
lines.zh: : 我还能继续吗？还是说你们几个打算就这么接一整天的吻？

lines.en: : Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto？

lines.en: : Is that an invitation to kiss you or are you asking for me to weigh in on something Miss Imai has clear authority on?
lines.zh: : 你这是在邀请我吻你，还是在问我对一件 Imai 老师显然更有发言权的事的看法？

lines.en: : It’s one of those things, yes.
lines.zh: : 是的，就是其中一种。

lines.en: : Aight, I’m just gonna go for it.
lines.zh: : 行吧，那我就直接往下说了。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro3
: Now, you may be wondering why we’ve decided to call this year’s Dorm Wars “Heaven & Hell.” And no, the answer has nothing to do with Yasu.
lines.zh: : 现在，你们大概在想，我们为什么要把今年的宿舍战争叫做「天堂与地狱」。不，答案和 Yasu 没有关系。

lines.en: : It does, however, have something to do with the way the competition will be split up this year.
lines.zh: : 不过，它确实和今年比赛的分组方式有关。

lines.en: : The first day will be “Heaven.” And we’ll have a bunch of lighthearted and fun stuff, some old and some new, that most of the class will be participating in.
lines.zh: : 第一天是「天堂」。我们会安排一大堆轻松又好玩的项目，有老有新，班上大部分人都会参加。

lines.en: : The second day is one that Uta has been pressuring me into for an entire year now because “supervision hampers creativity and competition” or something like that.
lines.zh: : 第二天嘛，是 Uta 缠了我整整一年才争取到的，理由是「监督会扼杀创造力和竞争心」还是什么的。

lines.en: : Imani also couldn’t bring herself to be around for the resurrection of the Date War. You’re welcome, class!
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，Imani 也是实在受不了亲眼看着约会战争复活才答应的。不用谢，全班！

lines.en: : Just as an FYI though, this doesn’t mean day two will be complete and utter chaos as I’ll still be filling in for Miss Imai as “supervisor.”
lines.zh: : 不过先说明一下，这不代表第二天就会彻底乱成一锅粥，因为我还是会代替 Imai 老师担任「监督」。

lines.en: : There will, however, be several competitions that we will run on our own without her help — similar to the way things were during the first Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 但是，会有好几项比赛由我们自己来办，不需要她帮忙——就像第一次宿舍战争那时候一样。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro4
: It’s all with Imani’s blessing, though! And shouldn’t be misinterpreted as us not wanting to be around her since last year’s competition was some of the most fun we’ve ever had!
lines.zh: : 不过这一切都得到了 Imani 的准许！可别误会成我们不想和她待在一起，因为去年的比赛是我们玩得最开心的一次！

lines.en: : Unless your name is Ami or Maya and you threw the entire first floor’s case into jeopardy in pursuit of personal gain.
lines.zh: : 除非你叫 Ami 或者 Maya，为了一己私利把一楼整层的局面都搞砸了。

lines.en: : Less guilt tripping, more praise. It’s not often you get a teacher who has so much faith in you that she lets you spend your weekend alone.
lines.zh: : 少往我身上泼愧疚，多夸夸我吧。能碰上一个这么信任你们、肯让你们单独过一个周末的老师，可不常有。

lines.en: : It probably should be.
lines.zh: : 或许确实该常有。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro5
: Anyway, Sensei will be coming back to participate this year. But, and sorry to break your hearts, he’ll also be abstaining from day two. Right, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 总之，Sensei 今年会回来参加。不过，抱歉要让你们心碎了——第二天他也会缺席。对吧，Makoto？

lines.en: : Why yes. That is absolutely correct.
lines.zh: : 是的，完全正确。

lines.en: : We don’t want him there anyway. Day two is for girls only. A boy would just ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 反正我们也不想让他待在那儿。第二天是女生专属。男生在场只会毁掉一切。

lines.en: : Any questions before we get to the contest announcements? From people not named Kirin who aren’t going to ask me to bone them?
lines.zh: : 在公布比赛项目之前还有什么问题吗？除了那个叫 Kirin 的、想让我跟她上床的人之外？

lines.en: : I have one. Is there actually going to be a prize this year or are we just doing this for bragging rights again?
lines.zh: : 我有一个。今年到底有没有奖品，还是说我们又只是争个嘴上的面子？

lines.en: : I don’t know. We’ll figure that out later. That’s all the time we have for questions, though!
lines.zh: : 不知道。这个以后再说。不过提问时间到此结束！

lines.en: : That was hardly five parsecs!
lines.zh: : 那根本连五个秒差距都不到！

lines.en: : Parsecs are a measurement of distance! How many times must I explain this to you?!
lines.zh: : 秒差距是长度单位！我要跟你解释多少遍才够？！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro6
: Makoto, why don’t you go ahead and-
lines.zh: : Makoto，你不如直接来——

lines.en: : Way ahead of you, Miss Imai. One last note before we begin, though. Uta?
lines.zh: : 我已经抢先一步了，Imai 老师。不过在开始之前还有最后一条通知。Uta？

lines.en: : You may find that some of this year’s match-ups involve competitors who we imagine would struggle at them.
lines.zh: : 你们可能会发现，今年有些对决的选手，在我们看来本来就不太擅长那些项目。

lines.en: : Which is why the first contest we will announce is another trivia game. This time between Miku and Yasu.
lines.zh: : 所以我们要公布的第一项比赛，是又一场知识问答。这次由 Miku 对上 Yasu。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro7
: Please tell me it’s sports trivia.
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我是体育知识问答。

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : My life is over.
lines.zh: : 我的人生完蛋了。

lines.en: : We’ll get through this together, Miku. Even if we’re on opposite teams.
lines.zh: : 我们会一起熬过去的，Miku。就算我们分属不同的队伍。

lines.en: : Rough start. At this rate, Kirin’s going to get forced into an abstinence contest.
lines.zh: : 开局不利。照这个节奏下去，Kirin 怕是要被塞进禁欲比赛了。

lines.en: : Close! Kirin’s competing in a one-on-one D&D match against Chika!
lines.zh: : 差一点！Kirin 要比的是和 Chika 一对一的龙与地下城对决！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro8
: That’s the same exact thing! Just somehow even worse!
lines.zh: : 那不就是一回事嘛！只是更惨而已！

lines.en: : Objection! The Dungeons and Dragons community has just as much intercourse as any other! Probably more! And just because you don’t understand-
lines.zh: : 反对！龙与地下城圈子的性生活和别的圈子一样多！说不定还更多！仅仅因为你不理解——

lines.en: : Sorry, Molly! Don’t speak virgin! Can’t understand you!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Molly！别说处女语！听不懂！

lines.en: : Maaaan! I want that one! Onee-chan and I used to 1v1 all the time since we couldn’t find anyone else to play with us.
lines.zh: : 可恶啊！我想要这个项目！姐姐和我以前经常 1v1，因为我们找不到别人一起玩。

lines.en: : Let’s hope Noriko doesn’t wind up in a blowjob contest since saying things like that makes her actively less likely to ever get laid!
lines.zh: : 那我们只能祈祷 Noriko 别被安排进口活比赛了，毕竟她说这种话只会让她更不可能被上。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro9
: I’d be great at that. No gag reflex, remember?
lines.zh: : 那个我超在行的。没有咽反射，记得吧？

lines.en: : I don’t believe you. We will need to have our own contest so you can prove it to me.
lines.zh: : 我不信。我们得单独办一场比赛，你好向我证明。

lines.en: : Ahem! There will be no sexual competitions since you are all in high school.
lines.zh: : 咳咳！不会有性相关的比赛，因为你们都还是高中生。

lines.en: : Also Kirin, you have detention for calling nerds virgins. There are a lot of nerds in this class. You are severely outnumbered.
lines.zh: : 还有 Kirin，你因为管宅男叫处女，被罚留校了。这个班宅男可多了去了。你在人数上处于绝对劣势。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro10
: Ugh. My only saving grace is that I’m going up against Chika.
lines.zh: : 唔。我唯一的救命稻草就是对手是 Chika。

lines.en: : At least you have a saving grace. I don’t know anything about literally anything. It’s all just wieners and balls now. Both kinds of balls. I am doomed.
lines.zh: : 至少你还有根救命稻草。我是对任何事都一无所知。现在脑子里全是鸡巴和蛋。两种蛋都有。我死定了。

lines.en: : What’s my contest, guys? Do I get the Date War again? Please tell me I get the Date War again.
lines.zh: : 那我参加什么比赛啊，各位？还是约会战争吗？拜托告诉我是约会战争。

lines.en: : We just put you in a cooking competition against Yumi since you’re good at everything and everyone else is afraid of her.
lines.zh: : 我们刚把你安排进了和 Yumi 对垒的厨艺比赛，因为你什么都会，而其他人全都怕她。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro11
: Yay! More quality time with my best friend! I can’t wait to tell her when she finally shows up to class!
lines.zh: : 耶！又能和我最好的朋友共度美好时光了！等她终于来上课，我一定要马上告诉她！

lines.en: : Hey! I’m supposed to be your best friend!
lines.zh: : 喂！我才是你最好的朋友吧！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro12
: Rin, will you help me learn D&D so I can wipe the floor with Kirin so bad that we’ll be cleaning her blood off of it for the next year?
lines.zh: : Rin，你能教我龙与地下城吗，好让我把 Kirin 打得落花流水，惨到接下来一年都得擦地板上的血？

lines.en: : You mean like what we already did with Nodoka’s after Yumi beat the crap out of her?
lines.zh: : 你是说像 Yumi 把 Nodoka 揍得半死之后，我们拿 Nodoka 家地板干的那样？

lines.en: : Yeah, just worse.
lines.zh: : 对，只是更惨。

lines.en: : Sure, I can teach you. Just don’t let it negatively impact your view of me since I may or may not have attempted to shield you from the fact that I know how to play at all.
lines.zh: : 行，我可以教你。只是别因此影响你对我的看法，因为我可能一直有在刻意掩饰自己其实会玩这件事。

lines.en: : But I like you being a nerd. It’s cute.
lines.zh: : 可我喜欢你是个宅女。很可爱啊。

lines.en: : I can’t wait to show you my dice.
lines.zh: : 我等不及要给你看我的骰子了。

lines.en: : Is it just me or do those two flirt a lot now?
lines.zh: : 是我多心了，还是她们俩现在真的调情调得很凶？

lines.en: : It’s definitely not just you. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是你多心。别担心。

lines.en: : Let’s see, let’s see...oh! Moving right along, our next contest is another one we’ve done before!
lines.zh: : 让我看看，让我看看……哦！接着往下，我们的下一场比赛又是个老项目！

lines.en: : And one that will hopefully not be nearly as awkward or uncomfortable as the last time we did it based on who we’ve chosen to compete this time around.
lines.zh: : 而且鉴于这次选的选手，希望它不会像上次那样尴尬、那样让人如坐针毡。

lines.en: : You know it! You love it! Stand-up comedy is back! And this time, it’s a battle between our most buxom beauties, Futaba Fukuyama and Touka Tsukioka!
lines.zh: : 没错！你们喜欢的！你们爱看的！单口喜剧回来了！而这一次，是我们最傲人的两位美女之间的对决——Futaba Fukuyama 对阵 Touka Tsukioka！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro13
: Wait! S...Stand-up?! Comedy?! You...expect me to...go on stage and...be funny?!
lines.zh: : 等等！单……单口？！喜剧？！你们……要我……上台……搞笑？！

lines.en: : No! That’s exactly why we picked you.
lines.zh: : 不！我们选你恰恰就是因为这个。

lines.en: : This is perhaps the most cruel thing anyone has done to me yet.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我至今为止被人做过最残忍的事了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Futaba! We’ll all be right there cheering you on!
lines.zh: : 别担心，Futaba！我们都会在场边给你加油的！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro14
: That’s exactly the problem!
lines.zh: : 问题就出在这儿啊！

lines.en: : Futaba’s had stage fright for as long as I’ve known her. She’s also chronically unfunny.
lines.zh: : Futaba 从认识她那天起就有舞台恐惧症。而且她长期性地不好笑。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Thanks, Rin! I really appreciate that! I can definitely do my best now!
lines.zh: : 谢了，Rin！我太受鼓舞了！现在我绝对能发挥出最好的水平了！

lines.en: : Conventionally unfunny! I think you’re perfect in every way. But the world disagrees. All of it. And they are probably right because they’re not biased like me.
lines.zh: : 是传统意义上的不好笑！我觉得你各方面都完美。但全世界不这么想。所有人都不。而且他们大概是对的，因为他们不像我一样带有偏见。

lines.en: : Again! Thank you!
lines.zh: : 又说一遍！谢谢你！

lines.en: : Heh...
: Finally something that caters to my strengths.
lines.zh: : 总算有个能发挥我长处的项目了。

lines.en: : You think you can do it, Touka? You won’t get nervous?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能行吗，Touka？你不会紧张？

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro15
: Nervous? Please. I’ve had eyes on me since the moment I was born. Which doesn’t even touch upon the fact that I’ve been taking rakugo lessons since I was a child.
lines.zh: : 紧张？拜托。我从出生那一刻起就活在众人的目光里。更别提我从小就在学落语了。

lines.en: : Rakugo?
lines.zh: : 落语？

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro16
: Did someone call for a weebnote?!
lines.zh: : 有人呼叫二次元小知识了吗？！

lines.en: : Rakugo, meaning “fallen words,” is a traditional form of Japanese verbal comedy dating all the way back to the 18th century! It’s not something just anyone can do either!
lines.zh: : 落语，意为「落下的话语」，是一种可以一路追溯到 18 世纪的日本传统口头喜剧形式！而且这可不是随便谁都能做的！

lines.en: : Rakugo employs a strict tier structure where one must work their way up from apprenticeship under the tutelage of someone who has already done that!
lines.zh: : 落语采用严格的等级制度，必须先在已经走过这条路的人门下当学徒，一步步往上爬！

lines.en: : And while it’s this exact formula and cycle that adds to the beauty of the craft, it’s also the primary contributor to the unfortunate fact that it’s a dying art!
lines.zh: : 虽然正是这套程式与循环造就了这门艺术的美丽，但它同时也是这门艺术正在消亡这一不幸事实的主要原因！

lines.en: : That said, there are still around 300-400 routines that are performed regularly to this day and-
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，至今仍有大约 300 到 400 段落语被定期演出，而且——

lines.en: : Okay, I get it now.
lines.zh: : 好了，我懂了。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro15
: Then my job here is done!
lines.zh: : 那我的任务就完成啦！

lines.en: : Touka, as impressive and unsurprising as your apparent rakugo training is, I don’t think that’s what the girls are looking for and I can’t imagine you grabbing a W with it.
lines.zh: : Touka，你的落语功底确实令人惊叹，也确实不出我所料，但我不觉得那是女生们想看的，而且我也想象不出你能靠它拿下一城。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro17
: I did not intend to.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算那么做。

lines.en: : What you will receive instead is a surprisingly modern stand-up comedy routine that even the shockingly handsome American movie star, Seth Rogen, would envy.
lines.zh: : 你们将看到的，是一段出人意料地现代的单口喜剧表演，就连那位帅得离谱的美国电影明星 Seth Rogen 都会嫉妒。

lines.en: : Did I...Sorry, did I just hear that right?
lines.zh: : 我……等等，我刚听错了吗？

lines.en: : You sure did, Imani. You sure did.
lines.zh: : 你没听错，Imani。你一点都没听错。

lines.en: : That’s amazing, Touka! I wish I could be as well-versed in entertaining people as you! All I can do is scare them!
lines.zh: : 好厉害啊，Touka！我要是也能像你这样精通逗人开心的本领就好了！我只会吓人！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro18
: That’s not true, Yasu! Cheer is a form of entertainment and you were quite exceptional at that during last year’s event!
lines.zh: : 才不是呢，Yasu！啦啦队也是一种表演，去年的活动上你就表现得相当出色！

lines.en: : Y-A-S-U! Guess who is my favorite?! You!
lines.zh: : Y-A-S-U！猜猜谁是我的最爱？！是你！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro19
: My, you’re becoming cuter by the day! I find it so hard to believe you used to sleep in an alley.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你真是越来越可爱了！真难相信你以前还睡过小巷子。

lines.en: : Otoha — would you hug me?
lines.zh: : Otoha——你能抱抱我吗？

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro20
: Sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，什么？

lines.en: : Hug me. Would you do it?
lines.zh: : 抱我。你愿意吗？

lines.en: : Is there...context to this? Or...
lines.zh: : 这有什么……前因后果吗？还是说……

lines.en: : Does there need to be?
lines.zh: : 非得有吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka, are you dying?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你是不是快死了？

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro21
: Not that I’m aware of. I’m just curious. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 据我所知不是。我只是好奇。就这样。

lines.en: : Uhhh...
: Well, if you’re talking about right now, no.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果你说的是现在，那不行。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro22
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because we’re in the middle of class. Context is important when it comes to physicality and...stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 因为我们还在上课。肢体接触和……那一类的事情，场合是很重要的。

lines.en: : But if the conditions were right, you would hug me?
lines.zh: : 但如果条件合适，你就会抱我？

lines.en: : I...guess? Are you seriously okay? Is something going on or-
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧？你真的没事吗？是不是发生了什么，还是——

lines.en: : Just to clarify, this isn’t a sexual thing. I’m talking about a platonic hug. The kind that friends share with one another.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚，这不是那种色色的事。我说的是纯洁的拥抱。朋友之间会做的那种。

lines.en: : That...is also what I was talking about.
lines.zh: : 那……也是我刚才说的那种。

lines.en: : Okay. I just wanted to be sure.
lines.zh: : 好。我只是想确认一下。

lines.en: : Uhhhh...okay.
scene dormwarsfiveintro23
: That’s all. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 就这样。谢谢你。

lines.en: : The fuck, yo?
lines.zh: : 搞什么鬼啊，喂？

lines.en: : Now, Makoto — to celebrate Sensei coming back into the picture and definitely not being around for day two, it wouldn’t feel right to just ignore him, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，Makoto——为了庆祝 Sensei 重回舞台，也绝对不是因为第二天他不在场，就这么把他晾着好像也不太合适，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhhh...hold on. I can’t remember where I put my index card- ah! Here. Ahem.
lines.zh: : 呃……等一下。我记得不清把索引卡放哪儿了——啊！在这儿。咳咳。

lines.en: : Why yes, Uta. And considering that the date war takes place on day two, there just had to be something we could do for him. Which is why-
lines.zh: : 当然，Uta。而且考虑到约会战争在第二天，我们总得为他安排点什么。所以——

lines.en: : My line. Which is why we’ve decided to include a brand new contest all about being as nice to him as you possibly can!
lines.zh: : 那是我的词。所以我们决定加入一项全新的比赛，内容就是尽你所能对他好！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro24
: They’re going to give this one to me, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 这个肯定要落到我头上，是吧？

lines.en: : And who better to compete than Maya Makinami and Otoha Okakura?
lines.zh: : 还有谁比 Maya Makinami 和 Otoha Okakura 更适合参赛呢？

lines.en: : Another year, another loss.
lines.zh: : 又一年，又一次落败。

lines.en: : At least I get to compete against Maya, though.
lines.zh: : 不过至少这次对手是 Maya。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro25
: Going in with any battle plan, Maya? Or are you just gonna fuck him?
lines.zh: : 有什么作战计划吗，Maya？还是说你就打算直接上了他？

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s allowed.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那应该不算允许范围吧。

lines.en: : Damn, Ami. Is subtlety just not even a thing for you anymore or what?
lines.zh: : 靠，Ami。你身上是一点含蓄的细胞都不剩了吗？

lines.en: : I’m just thinking of how to win and taking all of Maya’s strengths into consideration. And I don’t think she knows how to be nice to Sensei without fucking him.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想怎么赢，而且把 Maya 的所有长处都考虑进去了。我不觉得她除了上了 Sensei 之外，还懂得怎么对他好。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro26
: She’s not wrong.
lines.zh: : 她说得没错。

lines.en: : Of course she’s wrong! I’ve seen you be nice to Sensei plenty of times! And I highly suggest you don’t do what Ami said because this is a day one contest!
lines.zh: : 她当然错了！我见过你好多次对 Sensei 很好的样子！而且我强烈建议你别按 Ami 说的做，因为这是第一天的比赛！

lines.en: : So if it was day two-
lines.zh: : 所以如果是第二天——

lines.en: : Let’s just all fuck him together. As best friends.
lines.zh: : 那我们就一起上了他吧。以好朋友的身份。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: It might be the only chance I ever have.
lines.zh: : 这可能是我这辈子唯一的机会了。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro27
: So can I inquire about why you two are touching me? Or-
lines.zh: : 我能问一下你们俩为什么在摸我吗？还是——

lines.en: : Because we love you. And Ami, stop being weird. Just because...certain information has come to light, doesn’t make it so everything must now revolve around-
lines.zh: : 因为我们爱你。还有 Ami，别犯病了。就算……某些事情已经曝光了，也不代表从此所有事都得围着——

lines.en: : I’m not talking about everything, Ayane. I just seriously want to win. And if we need to cheat, I say we do it.
lines.zh: : 我又没说所有事，Ayane。我是真的想赢。如果需要作弊，我说那就作弊。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro28
: Why do you want to win so badly? There isn’t even a prize yet.
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么想赢？现在连奖品都还没定呢。

lines.en: : Key word — yet. But if there is, it’ll obviously involve my dad. And if letting my friends fuck my dad gets me closer to my dad, I’m willing to take the hit.
lines.zh: : 关键词——还没。但如果有的话，显然会和我爸有关。而如果让我的朋友们上了我爸能让我离我爸更近，我愿意吃这个亏。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro29
: I have no clue who or what you are anymore, so I can’t figure out why this somehow still surprises me.
lines.zh: : 我已经完全搞不清你是谁、是什么东西了，所以也想不明白为什么这种事到现在还能让我吃惊。

lines.en: : Ami, while I understand that your life may suddenly be very confusing and...you may feel...betrayed about certain actions your friends have taken-
lines.zh: : Ami，我理解你的人生可能突然变得非常混乱，而且……你可能会对朋友们做过的某些事感到……被背叛——

lines.en: : I’m over it. New hair, new me. Scorned Ami has arrived and is ready to win the Dorm Wars by any means necessary.
lines.zh: : 我已经过去了。新发型，新我。被辜负的 Ami 已经上线，准备不惜一切代价赢下宿舍战争。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro30
: R...Regardless! I think Maya can easily win without doing something like that. Which is why I think she should just be normally nice to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不……不管怎样！我觉得 Maya 不用做那种事也能轻松获胜。所以我认为她只要正常地对 Sensei 好就行了。

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, I like Ami’s idea a little better.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我更喜欢 Ami 的主意一点。

lines.en: : Of course you do, slut.
lines.zh: : 你当然喜欢，骚货。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro31
: I like it less when you put it like that.
lines.zh: : 你这么说我就没那么喜欢了。

lines.en: : Sorry. Slip of the tongue.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。口误。

lines.en: : Hah...I miss our old dynamic.
lines.zh: : 哈啊……我怀念我们以前的关系。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro32
: With only two contests remaining on day one, why don’t we break out the most exciting news yet, Makoto?!
lines.zh: : 第一天只剩两项比赛了，不如我们把最劲爆的消息放出来吧，Makoto？！

lines.en: : Because we could get into legal trouble for endangering the lives of everyone in class.
lines.zh: : 因为我们可能会因为危害全班同学的生命安全而惹上官司。

lines.en: : THEN LET’S FRIGGIN’ ENDANGER ‘EM! DEATH BALL’S MAKIN’ A COMEBACK, BABY!
lines.zh: : 那就他妈的去危害他们啊！死亡球要回归啦，宝贝！

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro33
: Oh no.
lines.zh: : 哦不。

lines.en: : What the hell is “Death Ball?”
lines.zh: : 「死亡球」到底是个什么鬼东西？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but I feel like I’d be really good at it.
lines.zh: : 不知道，但感觉我好像会特别擅长。

lines.en: : We played it last year while you two were...away. It was, uhh...
lines.zh: : 去年你们俩……不在的时候我们玩过。那个，呃……

lines.en: : It was big.
lines.zh: : 那场面很大。

lines.en: : My time has come once more.
lines.zh: : 我的时代又一次到来了。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Tsunecchi, no it hasn’t. Your contest is on day two. We figured letting you play would be an unfair advantage after last year.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，Tsunecchi，还没到。你的比赛在第二天。我们认为让你上场会是去年之后的不公平优势。

lines.en: : But hey! Your roommate gets to this time! And there might actually be a little less chaos since she’ll be going up against Ami in a slightly downscaled version of the game!
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来！这次轮到你室友了！而且因为她的对手是 Ami，玩的还是稍微缩小了规模的版本，说不定场面能不那么混乱！

lines.en: : How can one downscale that which is large enough to consume the world?
lines.zh: : 一个大到足以吞噬世界的东西，要怎么缩小规模？

lines.en: : Yay! Are we talking about God now?
lines.zh: : 耶！我们现在是在聊上帝吗？

lines.en: : In a sense, I think we are.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上，我觉得是的。

lines.en: : Uta, can I ask how exactly one plays “Death Ball?”
lines.zh: : Uta，我能问一下「死亡球」到底怎么玩吗？

lines.en: : Yes! You can. But there is no answer.
lines.zh: : 可以！你当然可以问。但这个问题没有答案。

lines.en: : And that’s because Death Ball plays you. Paramedics will be on premises this time. And there will be no documentary crew allowed.
lines.zh: : 因为死亡球玩的是你。这次现场会有急救人员。而且不允许任何纪录片摄制组进场。

lines.en: : Documentary crew?
lines.zh: : 纪录片摄制组？

lines.en: : Yeah. You two missed an entire timeskip.
lines.zh: : 对啊。你们俩错过了一整段时间跳跃。

lines.en: : Woah, crazy. No idea how I’d handle one of those.
lines.zh: : 哇哦，好疯狂。完全不知道我要是遇到那种事会怎么样。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro34
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You just...
lines.zh: : 你刚才……

lines.en: : That sounded a little sarcastic...is all.
lines.zh: : 那听起来有点阴阳怪气……就这样。

lines.en: : Mmm...I don’t think so. You didn’t hear any sarcasm there, right Maya?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得没有。你没听出什么阴阳怪气吧，Maya？

lines.en: : She sounded normal to me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她听起来挺正常的。

lines.en: : ...Okay.
: Sure.
lines.zh: : 随你吧。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro35
: Our final day one competition announcement is another brand new battle! One of wits and perseverance!
lines.zh: : 我们在第一天要公布的最后一项比赛，是又一场全新的对决！一场智慧与毅力的比拼！

lines.en: : And one I’m surprised you agreed to given that you seem slightly handicapped on an...intellectual level.
lines.zh: : 而且我很意外你居然会答应，考虑到你在……智力层面上似乎略有残疾。

lines.en: : Are you calling me dumb, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我笨吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : Not dumb per se. Just not nearly as smart as I am.
lines.zh: : 倒也不是笨。只是远远没有我聪明。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro36
: Then it appears we will have to put that to the test in a brand new, courtroom style battle between prosecutor Makoto and defense attorney Uta!
lines.zh: : 看来我们得用一场全新的、法庭式的对决来验一验了——由检察官 Makoto 对阵辩护律师 Uta！

lines.en: : Your funeral, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那就是你的葬礼了，我想。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro37
: But yeah — Uta and I will be battling it out in a case that a jury of our peers, you guys, will need to decide how to rule on.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的——Uta 和我会就一个案子展开交锋，而陪审团就是你们，由你们来决定如何裁决。

lines.en: : If Makoto gets my client convicted, she wins. But if the glove does not fit, I win!
lines.zh: : 如果 Makoto 能让我的当事人被判有罪，她就赢了。但如果手套不合手，那我就赢！

lines.en: : And while we can’t make you vote against your own floor if you’re just trying to win points-
lines.zh: : 虽然我们不能强迫你们为了得分就违背自己所在的楼层去投票——

lines.en: : We urge you not to so we can keep this as fair and even as possible!
lines.zh: : 但我们恳请你们别那么做，好让比赛尽可能公平公正！

lines.en: : Cool, yeah! Now bring on the stuff we get to do behind Imani’s back!
lines.zh: : 酷，好耶！现在快把那些能背着 Imani 干的项目端上来吧！

lines.en: : Yeah! We all want to know who’s in the date war this year!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！我们都想知道今年的约会战争有谁！

lines.en: : There are only three pairs left, aren’t there? Which means, from the first floor, it’s either Sana, Ayane, or-
lines.zh: : 只剩三组了对吧？也就是说，一楼那边，要么 Sana，要么 Ayane，要么——

lines.en: : The date war will be fought between Rin and Io.
lines.zh: : 约会战争将在 Rin 和 Io 之间展开。

lines.en: : But remember, it totally will not be with Sensei since he won’t be there.
lines.zh: : 不过记住，那绝对不是和 Sensei 约会，因为他不会在场。

lines.en: : Oh God...
lines.zh: : 哦上帝啊……

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro38
: Question — how does this work exactly? Because I have never paid attention to any of this before and I am suddenly very interested.
lines.zh: : 问一个问题——这到底是怎么进行的？因为我之前从来没关注过这些，而现在突然非常感兴趣了。

lines.en: : Basically Io, you just come up with a date idea and spend the morning or afternoon having fun based on whichever time slot you agree upon!
lines.zh: : 基本上就是，Io，你想出一个约会方案，然后按你们商定好的上午或下午时段，开开心心地玩一场！

lines.en: : And the person we are going on that date with is the one who chooses the winner? There’s no point system or anything like that?
lines.zh: : 而和我们约会的那个人，就是决定胜负的人？没有计分系统之类的？

lines.en: : That is correct, yes.
lines.zh: : 是的，没错。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, who is the date with exactly? Because I still haven’t heard-
lines.zh: : 话说回来，约会对象到底是谁？因为我一直没听说——

lines.en: : Me. I’m the date.
lines.zh: : 我。我就是那个约会对象。

lines.en: : And am I supposed to choose what you like or-
lines.zh: : 那我是应该迎合你的喜好，还是——

lines.en: : If that’s what you want, sure!
lines.zh: : 如果你想那么做的话，当然可以！

lines.en: : Or you can be cool and independent like me and show Uta a piece of your world, Io! I’m sure she’d love-
lines.zh: : 或者你也可以像我一样又酷又独立，带 Uta 去看看属于你的世界，Io！我相信她会喜欢——

lines.en: : Don’t talk to me. I’m thinking.
lines.zh: : 别跟我说话。我在想事情。

lines.en: : Guh. Another difficult target. She’s my next target after Yumi.
lines.zh: : 呃。又是个难啃的目标。Yumi 之后，她就是我的下一个目标了。

lines.en: : Good luck. I’ve been trying since she transferred in and I feel like she hates me even more now.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运。她转学过来那天起我就一直在努力，感觉她现在反而更讨厌我了。

lines.en: : One more question. Sorry. Is this really okay?
lines.zh: : 还有一个问题。抱歉。这样真的好吗？

lines.en: : Is what okay? The date war is practically a tradition at this point. Even if it was briefly outlawed along with our final competition.
lines.zh: : 什么好吗？约会战争到现在已经算是传统了。就算它曾经和最后一项比赛一起被短暂地禁止过。

lines.en: : Just...you know...letting me do this when I am the least interested in Dorm Wars out of everyone.
lines.zh: : 就是……你知道的……让我参加，可我是全班对宿舍战争最没兴趣的那个。

lines.en: : We wanted you to cooperate, Io. And hey! Maybe this will show you the Dorm Wars can be fun?!
lines.zh: : 我们希望你能参与进来，Io。而且嘿！说不定这能让你发现宿舍战争也可以很有趣呢？！

lines.en: : Thank you...I...appreciate this.
lines.zh: : 谢谢……我……很感激。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro39
: Of course! That said, only two contests remain now, girls! And one of them is an all time classic — the gothic lolita fashion show!
lines.zh: : 当然！那么，现在只剩下两项比赛了，姑娘们！其中一项是永恒的经典——哥特萝莉时装秀！

lines.en: : Lolita part optional this time as there seemed to be some confusion regarding the first floor girls’ entry the last time we did this.
lines.zh: : 这次「萝莉」部分可以省略，因为上次办的时候，一楼女生的参赛作品似乎引起了一些困惑。

lines.en: : We worked with what we had! It was hard! Not everyone can be Molly!
lines.zh: : 我们是利用手头现有的条件！那很难的！不是谁都能当 Molly 的！

lines.en: : Well let’s hope it’s less hard this time as you’ll be competing, Ayane! Against our very own CEO and self-proclaimed incest girl, Nodoka Nagasawa!
lines.zh: : 那就祈祷这次没那么难吧，因为参赛的是你，Ayane！对手是我们自己的社长、也是自称乱伦女孩的 Nodoka Nagasawa！

lines.en: : Nodoka? You in there? You hear that?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？你在听吗？听到了吗？

lines.en: : I wonder if Akira would hug me.
lines.zh: : 我在想 Akira 会不会抱我。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll just let you find out on your own.
lines.zh: : 好。那你自己慢慢想明白吧。

lines.en: : Yumi! You’re here! Guess what! We’re-
lines.zh: : Yumi！你来了！猜猜看！我们要——

lines.en: : Not in the mood. Couldn’t get to sleep last-
lines.zh: : 没心情。昨晚没睡着——

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro40
: Bro.
lines.zh: : 老兄。

lines.en: : Present.
: The fuck are you wearing?
lines.zh: : 你穿的这身是什么鬼？

lines.en: : I forgot which special event we were holding today. We have too many of them.
lines.zh: : 我忘了今天要办什么活动了。我们的活动实在太多了。

lines.en: : But a pleasant mistake it was as the world can now feast its eyes upon another MacCormack creation!
lines.zh: : 但这是个美丽的错误，因为世人现在又得以一饱眼福，欣赏另一件 MacCormack 出品了！

lines.en: : So are you tryin’ to blind everybody or what?
lines.zh: : 所以你是打算把所有人的眼睛都闪瞎是吧？

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro41
: Okay! So you should have all figured out by process of elimination now that the final pair of contestants consists of Sana and Tsuneyo!
lines.zh: : 好了！那么你们应该都靠排除法猜到了，最后一对选手是 Sana 和 Tsuneyo！

lines.en: : But we still haven’t revealed what they’re competing in! Just that it was something else we outlawed!
lines.zh: : 但我们还没公布她们要比什么！只知道那是另一件我们禁止过的东西！

lines.en: : Something that Imani specifically outlawed. But seeing as she and no one else is going to be present for it, we can do it again.
lines.zh: : 而且是 Imani 特意禁止的。不过既然她和其他人都不在场，我们就可以再来一次。

lines.en: : Though I kind of wish we wouldn’t since I cannot possibly understand how we will win this.
lines.zh: : 虽然我真希望我们别办，因为我实在想不出这回要怎么赢。

lines.en: : The swimsuit contest is back! And it’s sexy vs sweet this time as the tallest, most bodacious girl in class takes on...Sana. Who is Sana.
lines.zh: : 泳装比赛回来了！这次是性感对决甜美——全班最高、最火辣的女孩，对阵……Sana。就是那个 Sana。

lines.en: : Who...may just surprise us for reasons I can not explain. But I still imagine it will be an uphill battle.
lines.zh: : 而她……说不定会让我们大吃一惊，原因我也说不上来。但我仍然觉得这会是一场硬仗。

lines.en: : So I have to...show off my body in...in front of everyone?...
lines.zh: : 所以我要……在所有人面前……展示我的身体？……

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro42
: We can be exhibitionists together, Zagull Throat-
lines.zh: : 我们可以一起当暴露狂，Zagull Throat——

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene dormwarsfiveintro43
: Who is Zagull Throat-Tsuneyo? I know not of this person, nor the reason they bear my name.
lines.zh: : 谁是 Zagull Throat-Tsuneyo？我不认识这个人，也不知道他们为何顶着我的名字。

lines.en: : You know I need to ask you to take that off, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我得让你把那身脱了吧？

lines.en: : In front of everyone? Do you doubt my exhibitionism, bro?
lines.zh: : 在所有人面前？你是怀疑我的暴露欲吗，老兄？

lines.en: : No, I mean you aren’t allowed to wear that to school. We can’t get away with it like we can on Halloween.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说你不能穿那个来学校。这可不像万圣节那样能糊弄过去。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. Is being beautiful a crime now?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。难道美丽现在成了一种罪？

lines.en: : No, but indecent exposure is.
lines.zh: : 不是，但有伤风化才是。

lines.en: : Miss Imai, can’t you at least let her wear it until lunch? It’s quite difficult for the Kendo Princess to just slip out of-
lines.zh: : Imai 老师，您至少能让她穿到午休吧？要让剑道公主就这么当众脱下——

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, already?! How long have we been preparing for battle?!
lines.zh: : 等等，已经？！我们到底为了备战准备了多久？！

lines.en: : You were saying, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么，Molly？

lines.en: : That...uhh...
: Fine. I will strip for you, Miss Imai. But only because you asked.
lines.zh: : 好。我会为你脱的，Imai 老师。但只因为是你开口。

lines.en: : Whaaaa, no! I did not ask you to strip! Nor will I further comment on- why are you coming closer to me?!
lines.zh: : 哇啊，不！我可没让你脱！我也不会再就——你为什么在往我这边靠？！

lines.en: : Because it’s what you want. I understand when I am desired. Just know that I find this very inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 因为那是你想要的。我能读懂别人对我的渴望。只是我得说，我觉得这非常不合适。

lines.en: : Just...aah! Class dismissed! Everyone go eat! Maya last, though! I keep getting complaints about her!
lines.zh: : 就……啊！下课！所有人去吃饭！Maya 最后走！我一直在收到关于她的投诉！

lines.en: : Why am I so universally hated?...
lines.zh: : 为什么所有人都这么讨厌我？……
